task.objective: Adversarially review the PU-015 skills SDK review-handoff spec and trace plan.

findings.title: Self-reported provenance can be edited into a copied receipt and still pass handoff checks
findings.impacted_behavior: A copied review-plan receipt can be rewritten to match the current repo state and then accepted as if it were produced locally.

findings.title: The trace plan never actually proves the explicit handoff write path it promises
findings.impacted_behavior: A handoff implementation can ignore or reject repo-local writes and still satisfy the listed validation commands.

improvement_opportunities: Add an origin signal outside the receipt body for provenance validation.
Add a dedicated handoff write smoke that uses --receipt-out.
strengths: Clear separation between review handoff packaging and review execution.
The updated spec now closes the earlier optional target/intent and symlink-escape concerns on paper.
validation_evidence: Line-numbered inspection of the spec, trace plan, parser contract, and schema completed successfully.
Live repo branch and HEAD were confirmed before reviewing the artifacts.
accountability.next_action: Tighten provenance and add a write-path smoke so the handoff contract is proven both read-only and explicit-write capable.

local_memory.evidence: Live spec, plan, schema, and parser evidence were sufficient; no memory-derived facts were needed for the review

useful_findings: self-reported provenance is not enough to reject edited copies
validation commands do not cover explicit handoff writes
avoided_false_positive: did not re-flag the optional target/intent hole
did not re-flag stale HEAD / target digest checks
did not re-flag symlink escape handling
positive_performance.evidence_quality: Strong because the review cross-checked the planning artifacts against the live parser contract and the trace plan's own validation list.
positive_performance.followed_scope: Stayed on the review-handoff planning slice and did not drift into implementation or external state.
reusable_learning: Any provenance field that can be recomputed from the same mutable file is not enough by itself to prove origin.
If a spec promises write behavior, the validation lane has to exercise a real write path, not just a read-only smoke.
